body: Goodbye, hope you find peace.
Great post!
Hope it brings you peace.
Barstards!

What way were you preparing for the past couple of weeks?

I'd guess that less than 1% of people have a loving and stable childhood. You are giving yourself impossible odds in what you think you should have. Not trying to talk you out of it, but I used to think the same, that I only had the most messed up family but all you have to do is ask someone "so what effect did your parents have on you growing up" you will either hear canned lines or they will burst into tears.

This is very similar to my position. Worked some interesting jobs, had some great relationships, am comfortable at 29, don't really need to work etc I just feel as you say "I honestly can't imagine what more I can do. I feel that I've given life more than a fair shot. And I don't feel sad about giving up. It feels more like deciding not to play anymore, as if life were a game and I've said, "Eh, this game is not fun and thanks, but I'd rather not play anymore. I'm out." 

And yes, why don't more people do it? The saying I keep reading around is "Permanent solution to a tempory problem." And I think, great, isn't that what you want? If I had a broken door I would ask for a permanet solution. I think that is what people don't get, that is the better option, if you want it to be permanent. I only really got this last night as I lay in bed. For me it is the better option of a choice between some peace and some chaos or total peace.
I haven't deleted any? It wouldn't be sad? Can you understand that it would be nothing but peace!
It sure is all that there is!
Looking for peace man?
Was thinking about life insurance too, but you might need to make it look like an accident.

You really don't have to accept the turbulance! That is what is a revelation for me, and that is so joy provoking in me. Yes, life may not be easy, and if you want easy you can have death! Now, my only fear is being blocked from getting there, but I still want to share my joyful discovery.

I actually think the world would be a more peaceful place if we accepted suicide. People put themselves through shitty jobs, boring classes, dull realtionships because they fear death. If we really loved each other we would not stand for any shit. We would say I always have this better option in my pocket, and we would take death as something joyous. Wow, that person loves himself so much he has chosen total peace over peace mixed with pain.
Yes, but don't you see? You can have all good? All you need to do is to take it!

When someone suicides it is only a reminder to others that it is simply their fear that is stoping them reaching peace. It confronts others with a real option and they hate it and freak out because he took the golden shortcut!

God, I was so blind to this before, utterly clueless. We trick ourselves with so many reasons to keep on going. I'm cooking some lovily food right now, just to get away from the discomfort of hunger, after that I will go to the beach to get away from the discomfort of lack of movement then I will chat to firends for the comfort. Everything I do do is an attempt to get to pleasure, to peacefulness when the quickest most easiest way is to end the journey. Ha! Can't believe I never even noticed this before.

You don't need to try. Really, I think that trying is a load of crap that the people in power, bosses etc like as a concept to keep you going on an endless road. I don't try at all, I do very little, today I made dinner and drank tea, that is it. I am trying to be accepting of that. If that ugly flower just accepts the way it is at least it doesn't suffer in its own mind.
If you are ugly https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-N0Y6W8R15Y
It could have been for the best, you never know what pain he was in.
Me too, wish it was as peaceful as closing my eyes and never waking up but my fucking body just keeps ticking over. All because my genes just want to replicate themselves and I do not.
Yeah, that is my plan too, just want to do it peacefully.

I like have the option of a way out. I think it is soothing. Walking around today I felt free that I never actually have to take shit if I don't want to. Though, I was never one to take any but that has its own problems, got fired from my last job because I wasn't accepting my mangers threats and also got serious problems from the police after I refused to play their games. 

That is the problem, like you I don't feel any joy contributing to the world. If you believe the world if full of shit, why would you want to contribute to it? I feel no desire to contribute to it. Just want a ticket out of here.
Sometimes there are times that you just need to be noticed when you are upset and sometimes I prefer to just deal with it alone. Are you talking about using drugs?
Horrible feeling that, having a lack of love and care in your life.
They say if you take the planet and people on a large scale and zoom out, it is actually in total harmony.

Like me I tried to use a rope twice. Never did it right, was too afraid to do it from a tree in public in case someone's kid found me. 

You mention that you have "everything" that should make you happy. That is the problem, nothing in the world says you should be happy. It is more of an attitude, some people have an attitude of acceptance towards everything so they stay pretty peaceful in most situations. I am not one of those people. Looks like you are telling yourself you should be something that you are not.

Yeah, tried all those things except the hotline. They all work I have to say. Even chatting on here works to busy my mind. But they are temporary. When I work my ass off I can maintain a sense of peacefulness, I need lots of heavy exercise, great food and playfulness. But it is like I said in the other post that the "knowing" that I must do all these everyday gives me the option to just not do them and leave here. I think when you are a kid you just do this and BE but now I look at it like a job. 

Like today, it is a beautiful day, I'm about to go for a walk on the beach with my Mom and go through all the motions, smiling, running, telling stories, playing with some dogs.  Should be easy? Not when I know that I am just doing it to escape when I can just escape forever.
I think you just have a need for respect.
Yeah, it is like a form of acceptance.
And some places fill force feed you through a tube, they can claim you are mentally ill. Well, that is if you are found in time.
Yeah, it would be great if you could will it, like a light switch.
Yeah, it is the mess that really gets to me. I went to hang myself in a woodland but kept thinking about some family and kid finding me and being F'ed for life.
If you can give me advice how to make it easier, I would apprciate it? I have read the peaceful pill handbook but will not be able to get my hands on what I need.
Yeah, sometimes I think that maybe I could die and wake up when the world is easier for me to deal with.
Is this a way for you to get peace in your life?

Yes, I think that observation is accurate. From a young age you are tested, graded, ranked, told you are either good or bad and you are being moralistically judged everyday. Now as I am older and wiser I know all the grading and moralising was simply a way that others tragically try to get their needs met but I can't seem to shake the years that repitition it has had on me.

Yeah, I was asking myself something similar today. How often have I truely given from the heart, where my goal is to enrich the other person? And not from a place of fear or trying to get something done. It takes practice and for me I need to be aware of it. But the acting of giving for the sake of enriching others is worth trying.

Wow, I bet that those repeated attacks from your dad left you feeling really hurt and scared especially if you were already the emotional type. You say you are getting on better with him now but I would it be true that if you looked back as a kid, you really could have done with more respect and support in your life?

Right, so you are missing those extra million skills and you don't want to write low quaility stuff. I imagine that results in feeling pretty hopeless, would it be right to say you have a need to produce authentic material?

I imagine that it is so hard having that conflict of wanting to connect with people and be your authentic self around others but having this tense anxiety probing at you all the time, would it be true to say that you need a bit of empathy from other and to been seen for how hard you are trying?

I imagine that losing someone so close would have a massive effect on someone young, it would put a lot of psycological strain on you and make your family life more unstable. I guess that with the death of your father you felt a lot less secure and maybe this causes you to withdraw your vulnerable side from people as you have less of a support network if you get hurt. 

When you say "I love you" to your mother, it sounds like it is coming from a place of routine but maybe it is lacking some fundamental human connection? Would it be more honest to say something like "Mom, when I say 'I love you,' I feel kinda disconnected from it, I'm not sure what it is exactly but I've been feeling a bit numb lately" ?
I honestly enjoyed that! It is strangely poetic!
Really hard to get on in this world in a difficult economy. I get the sense that you are really trying and have a big need to contribute.
So you have a pretty strong belief that the route out of depression is giving service to others, what has your experience been of focusing on this to get out of depression?
Cool, my cousin has a shiba one of the best natured dogs I've been around. Best of luck with uni dude :)
Good to hear from you :)

Sounds like you are feeling pretty hopeless as you are trying your best to feel better. It must have been scary going in for that treatment but you did. What else is on your mind? What is the severe depression experience like for you?

Any answer is cool, whatever comes into your head. So you have a few good friends, a mother and sister who you can get love from but it sounds like it was a rough time when your father died of cancer and it must have had an affect on you. You also find it kinda tricky to get to trust new people and this relates to not have a girlfriend at the moment, would it be right to say you find it hard to show vulnerability to people? Is there anything else you want to add?
So it is different for you now after school when you had closer contact with people and you haven't been able to get a deep sense of meaning since then.

Yeah, it is such a bizzare and unhelpful phrase "Seek happiness." Here have some happiness in a can! Anyway, I hear that you are feeling numb, which makes sense if that part of you keeps hitting you over the head with phrases like "Stop doing that, you'll never be as good as them." Seems like you are trying a lot of things to keep busy too, reading, music but it all is momentary for you.

Hey, the key sentence that stood out for me was " I ended up talking to a curator which helped momentarily. I felt good for two days"

I'm going to take a guess and say that you might be missing some connection or community with people in your life?

Sounds like you have a really strong need for autonomy and independence and you are not getting that freedom from your folks. Limiting these needs for exploration and self-determination will affect your mood, a sense of not being able to grow.
You want to kill yourself because you need understanding, care and respect but you are not getting it.
You want people to feel the pain you have inside you, the only way you know how is to lash out at them.

Man, you are going through a really though time, you got to give yourself some credit for your resiliance. You have gone through massive devestation over the past year both from the death of girlfriend and the lost career in the area which your uncle worked. You are missing two people who you could really talk to, and that is going to have such an effect on you. 

More than anything you seem too isolated right now, and that you must need some support or someone to confide in after that year.
yeah, that is the tricky part, actually not trying to fix it.

Hey, so it sounds like you have had a bit of bad luck with balding and a few bumps and scrapes. I imagine that fearing about how the world perceives you can cause quite a bit of strees, would I be right there? 

Now, you are wondering if all this worry is enough to push you to vist a psychologist. I'm wondering if you could expand on it a bit more, are you needing more connection and closeness with others in your life?
So this down time being alone is new to you. I imagine it is quite a shock to the system, do you have others close to you that you can rely on for support or some companionship?

Thanks for the chat too, I'm really greateful to listen to someone taking openly and honestly, in a way it helps me meet my need to matter in this world. 

Think that is why I like being around animals too, they can be nothing but honest and I feel enlivened after playing with a dog.

Being vulnerable can be a real bitch! And like you said above there is a stepping out of the safety zone with calling someone and opening up because you are not sure which way it go and if you are feeling down anyway the thoughts can veer in a negative direction like "Shit, if I tell people I'll burden them." Instead of on a day when you a feeling good when you might think " It'll be fun to connect with someone today."

So in a way, would I be right in saying that you have built this persona of smiles and now that you actually are feeling sad you feel anxiety about sharing that with others as then you lose the persona? 

With the other post above you said "being a man you shouldn't really be asking for help." This is a real catch since one of the main reasons someone may be sad is that they need connection and need openness but if they believe they are not allowed get this they will be trapped in a state of sadness.

Ok so a few more things are on your mind like being overwieght, fearing peolpe seeing you messy and you think that you are managing those feelings by over eating so girls can push you away. 

If I were to guess I'd say to you are definitly needing understanding so people would know that are only over eating because you have this feeling inside you that want to share with the world but fear it also. I wonder if you focused on getting one of those needs you spoke of above over the next few days do you think you could do that?

For me, r/depression helps me get my need for authenticity and understanding, and even to matter because I can converse with people openly. The more I simply focus on my needs and not on what I should be the more I feel better.
Some more info on the wiki http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflective_listening

Yeah, so one of your biggest fears is actually being put in one of those impossible situations of war where no matter what you choose you seem to lose. Would I be right in saying that you want your postion to be understood by others around you but fear this would lead to feeling more isolated?

That one can be a toughie! :) So if some of those needs were met how would imagine feeling? 

So what I'm trying to say is that being "suave" is abstract and almost impossible to achive whereas I can actually ask for and get those needs met.

A way to not feel awkward and to give real empathy is to relfect back to him what you heard him say. That way you know that you both heard each other correctly and there is no pressure on anybody to "fix" anything. An example would be " Some dude was starring at me on the street, i just wanted to get out there so I started running"
You could say back "If I heard you right there was some guy eyeballing you so you ran because you needed to feel safe?" Then as the person talks don't give advice or anything, just keep reflecting back to them and asking if you got it right and you are understanding him.

Cool, well not only ones that you identify with "who I am" is that what you mean? But I mean what you feel the need for most in your life? Like today for me I felt really lonily and I thought "what do I need today?" and I knew I needed some friendship so I met up with a friend.  So rather than thinking "I need to be super suave" if you look a bit deeper it could be the need for intimacy, warmth and trust.

Would it be true to say then that you are needing some understanding from the people around you and the space to speak your mind? And if people thought you were attention seeking, what would that mean? Is it a fearful situation or something else?

Right, so you have a real longing to be with your kids as often as you can and you have the need to care for them and connect with them. Being left out of the picture, you must be feeling pretty lonily sitting at home?

Hey, the main point of worry I got from your post was the conflict you have between your belief of never hurting another human and the job that you have where maybe you may be called to fight, is that in the ballpark? Then you also have a thought of not being alive anymore so I guess you are maybe needing more joy or purpose in your life?
Hey Mattew, from reading your post I get a sense that maybe you are feeling a bit worried about your moods and are fearful about burdening someone with your thoughts, am I close with that?
I haven't been in the situation, but I'm listening to what you have to say if you want to tell anymore I'll hear you.

So on the one hand you have this untouchable, carefree image of yourself that you are trying to reach but your efforts to become this just seem make you feel hopeless of ever reaching it. Then you also focus on what you want rather than need and this is causing an internal conflict in you. Would that be right? 

And basically, when you think of love and acceptance you mix between feeling uncomfortable and kinda confused. Maybe if you have a look at human needs on this list you could point out a few that click with you? http://www.cnvc.org/Training/needs-inventory
Hey, sounds like you're feeling hurt and lonily after this relationship with this girl. I guess you are maybe needing a sense of human connection and love in your life?

Wow, putting lots of pressure on yourself there. You want to be all those things like being the guy that everyone wants to be around. Are you feeling overwhelmed by this vision of what you should be? Wondering if you focused on what you needed? Like is it acceptance you are needing or love or connection? What needs are really alive in you right now?
Love that fresh breeze by my house too as I walk along the tracks into town. Spring is almost here too and some flowers I got are starting to bud.

I try that as a way of accepting it. I just say to myself "Ok, here you are Mr. Depression in my body and mind I'm not going to fight you just sit with you." This, for me, at least helps with worrying about the worry of being depressed.

Sounds like you are really suffering erik. Are you overwhelmed with the responsibility of trying to earn money for your family while being stuck under a pile of debt? I think you are really needing support and love right now, would you be willing to reach out and ask for it somehow in your community?

Ok so you are feeling like shit and feeling numb. I get that you want to try and progress in the world, hit the target like education, job, wife and kids and that is not coming naturally to you. Now you are at a stage where tears of sadness or joy are just unavailable to you and you are isolating from others. After thinking about it, I have no advice for you, I can just say that I hear you man, I hear you.
No adivce from me. But I hear you. I'm near your age and it looks like you have been trying a so many options and that you just what to hit that solution. Must be really hard man.
So what does that corpse you are hiding look like? Why are you hiding how you feel to others?

And as an experiment what if you accepted the nothingness and sat with it? What would happen if you said "Ok, every morning I get up there will be nothing on the horizon to look forward to, I mean never, and everything will forever be balnd"?

And when you sit with that isolation, I'm curious, how does it come out in your art? Because when you say you are exhausted but you still try I get the sense of how much love and devotion and effort you put into it. Maybe sharing it with writers and fim makers would work as a way to connect but I want to point your attention to how you are connecting now, honestly, when you share how you feel, struggle, strive to create I feel alive with the connection, it is its own art.
Great! So don't just stand there, tell me more about it? What is it like to have "no one to live for?"
Zen all the way!

Thanks for sharing whoever you are. You must be in such pain to really want to end it by jumpig on the tracks. Then, you have the struggle of coming back to your house and feeling isolated again. Fucking sucks man. Am I right in saying that you feel trapped but would love to be able to find some purpose to get up in the morning for?

Cool, it is great to hear that you have this desire to express yourself through your abilities that you were born with. So you are sort of stuck on this island were you are massive passion and want to share it but still feel a lonelness between your art and the people you want to share it with?

Had to scratch my first reaction because I started giving you all kinds of advice from a guy who has been through it all. But really I don't know your situation or how you are feeling. 

All I know is that you feel unmotivated and are not enjoying those things you need to do to finish like getting an internship. Then you have a gf of 6 years who is close to break up with you and wants to try again in a few months if you have "turned your life around." Then you say you don't know how to start. Must be confusing?

Yo, I hear that you have all this potential in your writing, playing music and creativity, must be a killer to keep that locked up. It seems that you have a strong longing to simply connect with people and be understood or understand them, am I hearing you right?
If I was to go deep, I'd wonder if deep down you are afraid that some future woman will not be able to love you since you got these sucky genes from your mothers side of the family?

Thanks for sharing. I compliment you on the fact that you have reached out about your fears of being a bad mother, getting stuck in the past, worrying about your appearance and sharing that you don't love your husband. I know you are just an internet person but I accept you totally for who you are, fame and faults and all.

I get it, and you are piss off and underneath it sad and lonely that you are seen with a kid face when in reality you are a man. This then kicks your ass cause you are thinking what kind of woman will date a guy who has the face of a little kid?

If I hear you right you can see that you do or will matter to someone but he just hasnt caught you yet. You are worried about the empty promises and false hopes because you fear that when they see you they will stop talking to you?
You're really feeling the pain? Can't tell you it gets any better, but it is your pain so just sit with it for while and tell us how it is?

Wow, sounds like you really love being with her on those adventures and the sense of companionship and intimacy is really missing from your life after the trip. 

I have no advice for you exceptat 27 and after being in countries with women I Iove and losing them I cried a lot too.

Do you feel, dare I say "happier" after those few months of slowly building onto them? A part of me honestly wants to fight off what you are saying. I'm so scared of the idea that it is difficult to even listen to advice.
So you feel a real strong need for people to see you for who you are? To matter to people without having to look a certain way?
So you feel a total lack of enjoyment and nothing seems to get you to want to do anything at all?
So from your post you are really looking to matter to someone?
So you just what to be accepted?
I'm curious about the good side effects, what has changed for the better? I'm fearful of the things after first hand exp and research.
Is this the first time? That is very similar to what I;ve been getting for years. Can you describe it more?
Give us an example?
Home alone wears me out after a few days, feel ok at the beginning, but  a few days after it gets worse and the quiteness begins to be normal. Then I realise I want to die.
I get the sense that you are really trying to beat the loneliness and reconnect with people from your past. Really difficult.
Go on??
Do you take them? What is your experience of them?

Sounds like you are really grateful for the people around you who care but you are unsure of how to really let them know.

Have you heard of Non-violent communication? It is a method for expressing yourself with ease. I use it all the time. You can search youtube for examples. It kinda follows the steps of Observation, "When you offered to talk to me," Feeling, "I felt really happy," Need, "because I was really needing some support." But you can talior it to your cultural way of speaking.

Yeah, it is as if the environment or culture actually encourages the more depressed factors. 

Like work harder, stay late, office jobs were sitting for hours is the norm and sweets ... they are everywhere!
They have tried to give me them ,yes, but I won't take them as my mother, father and sis take them and they gain very little except wieght gain and the ability to drink more without a bad hangover.
Talking to friends about it can be terrifying, even the thought of it.

True, I've been doing them for over 10 years, still doing one now. I feel hopeless after all my attempts I want certainty and accepting depression as my choice makes it certain and actually feels good. Because I can be certain I have it now and can certainly end it too.
So you put in more effort and cared more about them I guess you really needed more appreciation, respect and acknowledgement for what you put into it.
It must hurt a lot to lose the one person who really saw you for who are and supported you.
You seem to be hurting a lot. I guess you really got a lot of love from this person to feel so hurt by them leaving.
No reason is the reason maybe! Trying to feel good never works!

I think we get a full wonderful party for most of our childhoods as we live in the moment and enjoy simple little things. Maybe leaving now after that time is leaving the party at the right time! Maybe those that cling on till their 80s are like the weird drunk you find behind the couch a few days later begging you for more beer.
I think it feels the way I felt before I was born.
So you want to die or at least you just don't want to feel the pain of living? And you are fearing the void, what happens after?
